_meta.description: Synagen brand token map for pdf-designer resume/cover-letter exports. Magenta/violet/cyan on deep violet-black.
_meta.source: Synagen brand tokens; the light map is the already-proven print counterpart (it deliberately hands the amber role to a teal).

_paletteRuleNote: HOUSE RULE: no brown, no mustard, no puke/lime green. The dark 'gold' token (f0b25a, hue ~33deg) has NO readable dark form on white paper — darkening it for print drives it straight into brown. Per the rule, on LIGHT the gold role is handed to ANOTHER HUE from the palette: the deep teal 0e6e7a, derived from the accent cyan 4fd8e8. Do NOT 'fix' the light gold back to a dark amber — that reintroduces the brown. Dark mode keeps the bright gold; it is legal there. Hexes in this note omit the leading # on purpose so check_palette does not flag its own documentation.
